description: E1 ramps 20->10 m/s over 4 s from t=1 (override). E2 (skip) triggers at t=2 while E1 runs: it must not run.

oracle.derivation: E2 is triggered while E1 is running; with priority skip it does not enter runningState (skipTransition to completeState). E1 completes at t=5.

expect.esminiNote: esmini keeps e2 in standby and starts it at t=5 once e1 is done (the "does not leave the standbyState" reading); the spec is self-inconsistent here, see D-16
